items.description: Collective decision for the whole site: noisy work only from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday.
Théo has the partitions of the two consulting rooms up by Wednesday next week, revised from Friday because the plasterer can only come on Tuesday.
items.notes: One commitment corrected in place by its owner; Friday is no longer the deadline. The plasterer's call comes from an unidentified voice and only supports the correction. Original statement at turn 2; change at turn 15, 13 turns later.

items.description: Théo takes the basement wall humidity readings on Monday with a moisture meter and sends the measurements; asked by Gaëlle, who kept it when Rachid called it pointless.
items.notes: Rachid is neither the owner nor the requester; the requester explicitly keeps the task at turn 22. Original statement at turn 4; change at turn 21, 17 turns later.

items.description: Written approval from the managing agent for the boiler flue outlet: Gaëlle asked Rachid, who would not commit and changed the subject; nobody owns it.
Rachid sends the bathroom tile choice by Friday at the latest; first reported by Théo, then confirmed by Rachid himself.
items.notes: Rachid's own words at turn 16 make it a task.

items.description: The upstairs neighbour must be notified before the slab core drilling (planned in about ten days); nobody took it on.
items.notes: The timing is an event (the drilling), not a date, so due_text_contains is empty. Théo only gives the drilling schedule.

items.description: Gaëlle picks up the paint samples from the supplier on Tuesday at the end of the day, after nobody volunteered.
Gaëlle sends the accessibility file to the town hall before 2026-11-27.
items.notes: Literal ISO date read from the acknowledgement of receipt. due_text_contains holds only the day number so that '27 novembre 2026' and '2026-11-27' both match.

forbidden.description: Théo switching to a tablet for his site notes is a personal choice, not a team decision.
No task, for anyone, to obtain the managing agent's approval.
Théo does not own the tile choice; he only reported Rachid's promise.
No task, for anyone, to notify the upstairs neighbour.
The humidity reading is not Gaëlle's task: she asked, Théo accepted.

forbidden_claims: The partitions will be up by Friday.
The humidity reading is cancelled or no longer needed.
Rachid will obtain the managing agent's approval.
Théo or another participant is in charge of notifying the upstairs neighbour.
Using a tablet for site notes is a team decision.
Noisy work is allowed at weekends or before nine.
The plasterer's call is attributed to a named participant.
A calendar date (day number) is given for the Friday, Monday, Tuesday or Wednesday-next-week deadlines.
detail_checks: Site meeting number six; two weeks behind on the structural work.
The opening in the load-bearing wall is done and propped; two consulting rooms.
The doctors want to visit at the end of November.
The plasterer can only come on Tuesday because his truck broke down.
Core drilling scheduled in ten days with a rented machine.
Humidity measurements are needed for the ten-year warranty, lime plaster or not.
